Commentary.Commentary: That's your lot for the day. Bangladesh bounced back to seal the deal with one match to go. The 5th T20I of this series will be played on Friday, 10th September 2021 at 4 pm local (10 am GMT). Do join us for all the action. Cheers!

Mahmudullah, the victorious captain of Bangladesh, starts by saying that the bowlers did a great job to restrict New Zealand. Praises Nasum Ahmed and Mahedi Hasan for their bowling and is impressed with the efforts of all the bowlers. Adds that the batters tried hard and they just needed a partnership. Mentions that Mohammad Naim batted very well and Afif Hossain was also excellent during his stay. Tells us that they wanted to take the chase deep and then take it forward. Credits all the boys and the team management for showing the hunger to win the series here. Signs off by saying that there is one more game left and that offers them the opportunity to regroup and work on areas to improve.

Nasum Ahmed is given the Player of the Match award. Says that he is delighted to win the series. Tells that his captain believes in him and gives him the freedom to plan his bowling. Adds that he concentrates on bowling accurate lines and doesn't think about anything else.

Tom Latham, the Kiwi skipper, says that they were slightly under par with their batting. Credits the way Bangladesh batted this evening as they had the chase under control despite losing wickets. Praises Mahmudullah for his knock and feels that Bangladesh managed to build a couple of partnerships. Mentions that Will Young batted superbly but losing wickets in clumps made it hard for them. States that they have been able to adjust to the conditions and they will take all the positives forward. Tom hopes to finish the series 3-2.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

The prime reason for New Zealand's defeat this evening was their flavourless batting. After batting so responsibly in the last match, the hopes were high from their batters. But apart from Will Young, no one succeeded and the Black Caps managed only 93 runs on the board. Still, their bowlers fought hard to drag this match into the last over. Ajaz Patel and Rachin Ravindra were exceptional in their spells and had New Zealand got a score of 115-120, this could have been a thrilling game.

The victory didn't come easy to Bangladesh. They had to work hard for every run. Liton Das departed early but Mohammad Naim held one end strongly. The hosts were in a spot of bother in the sixth over when Ajaz Patel removed both Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim in quick succession. The Kiwis had a sniff at that moment but the arrival of Mahmudullah to the crease brought calmness and his partnership of 34 runs with Naim was enough to keep Bangladesh's chase on track. The run out of Naim offered New Zealand an opening with 27 runs needed off 33 balls but they didn't take it. Mahmudullah's stumping was missed by Tom Latham when the hosts required another 20 runs. After that, it was an easy march towards the target for the Bangla Tigers. A hard-earned win for them to take an unassailable 3-1 lead in the series and this is also their first series win against New Zealand in T20Is.

Bangladesh have done it! They have tamed yet another team coming from Down Under. After successfully beating Australia in a T20I series recently, they have thumped New Zealand as well. The Bangla Tigers are building great momentum before the T20 World Cup. On the right path.

FOUR! That's it! Bangladesh have won the series with one game to spare! Tossed up outside off, Mahmudullah goes down on one knee and swings it over mid-wicket for a boundary. BANGLADESH WIN BY 6 WICKETS! Their dugout is ecstatic.
Full on middle, Mahmudullah drives it to long on for a single. Just 2 needed in the last over.
Short on middle, Hossain looks to pull but edges it onto his pads. The ball deflects to square leg and they take a run.
The physio comes out for the mandatory concussion check. Afif Hossain is smiling and is looking fine to continue. Another 4 needed for a win.

That hits the helmet! Ouch! Short ball around off, Hossain looks to fend it off by going on his toes but misses and gets hit on the helmet. Mahmudullah looks for a run but then decides against it as Blair Tickner is quick to reach the ball.
Good length around outside off, Mahmudullah makes room and then slashes it to third man for a single.
Slower ball outside off, Mahmudullah looks to force it on the off side but misses.
SIX! This should seal the deal! Tickner bowls it in the slot on off, Mahmudllah smacks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Just 5 needed now.
Blair Tickner to bowl now.
Short again, around off, Mahmudullah skips down the track and pulls it to deep square leg for a single. 11 needed off 12 balls.
Good length around middle, Mahmudullah uses his feet and then flicks it to deep square leg for a couple. Completes it with a dive.
Shortish delivery outside off, Afif forces it to deep cover for a single. 14 needed in 14 now.
Short on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it to deep square leg for one. 15 needed off 15 balls.
WIDE! On a length but going down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Slower short ball on off, Hossain punches it to mid off for one.
Short ball on off, Mahmudullah pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Bowling change. Hamish Bennett comes back into the attack. 2-0-9-0 are his figures so far.
Tossed up on off, Afif defends it to covers. Ajaz Patel is done with his fantastic spell this evening, 4-0-9-2. 19 needed off 18 balls.
Flatter on middle, Afif nudges it to mid-wicket.
Shortish ball outside off, slapped wide of long off for one.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Mahmudullah looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his boot.

An opportunity missed! Tom Latham misses a stumping. Tossed up outside off, Mahmudullah dances down the track and looks to swing it away but misses. Latham fails to collect as well and Mahmudullah comes back in safely.
Tossed up outside off, Mahmudullah looks to sweep but misses.
Ajaz Patel is back on. 2/8 in his 3 overs so far.
Full on off, Afif Hossain drives it to covers where the fielder makes a good half-stop but the batters do not take a run.
Full on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, played to deep cover for one.
EDGED! Full ball outside off, Mahmudullah looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge past the stumps to short fine leg. A single.
Lands it on a length outside off, it grips and turns away, Afif plays late and taps it down to short third man. They cross for a single.
Fuller and on middle, it's worked easily behind square leg for a single.

Uppish but wide of backward point! Short in length and wide outside off, Mahmudullah goes back and cuts it from the outer half of his blade. It beats the flying fielder inside the ring and they take a run. Nervy moment for Bangladesh, that.
On a good length, close to off, Mahmudullah hangs on the back foot, plays it late and defends it down safely.
Back of a length, around leg, Afif glances it to square leg and picks up a single.
Afif Hossain comes out to bat now.

OUT! Naim is run out! Needless. Short in length, angling down the leg side, Naim pulls it behind square leg and wants the second run. The throw comes flat to the keeper who takes the bails off. They appeal, it's referred upstairs but the replays show that even the dive has not saved Naim. A wicket against the run of play. Can New Zealand capitalize? 27 needed off 33 balls.
Commentary.Howout: run out (sub Doug Bracewell / Tom Latham)

Commentary.Commentary: An appeal for run out taken upstairs. New Zealand look optimistic. Mohammad Naim is well short of the crease.
A bouncer on middle, it's served from 'round the wicket, Naim ducks.
Short in length and wide outside off, Mahmudullah whacks it to deep cover and collects a single.
Blair Tickner is into the attack.
A full toss on off, it's knocked down to long on for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Mahmudullah defends it back.

MAHMUDULLAH IS SAFE! Fuller in length and drifting down the leg side, Mahmudullah tries to flick but misses. He loses his balance a bit as his back leg leaves the crease slightly. Latham collects the ball and breaks the stumps. He appeals and it's referred upstairs. Colin de Grandhomme thinks that Mahmudullah has edged it. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the edge on the UltraEdge. Nothing there. Now, it's time for the side-on angle. A tough call as the back leg appears to be on the line from one angle whereas another angle shows that some part of Mahmudullah's leg is inside the crease. The Bangla skipper is given not out and he can continue. 30 needed off 38 balls.

An appeal for stumping is taken upstairs. New Zealand are very confident. They are looking for the catch first. The UltraEdge shows no bat. What about the stumping? It seems that Mahmudullah's foot is on the line. No, as per the third umpire, as he gives Mahmudullah not out.
On middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Mahmudullah wrists it to square leg and pinches a single.
Fuller and closer to off, an off cutter, Mahmudullah defends it at the last moment to the off side.
Colin de Grandhomme is back on.
Flighted and on middle, turning in to cramp the left-hander, Naim defends it out on the leg side. Rachin Ravindra is done with his quota, went for only 8 runs in his 4.
Quicker one, flatter and shorter on off at almost 90 kph, Naim punches it out to mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, turning away, Mahmudullah pushes inside the line and softly eases it towards short third man for a single.
Turning away from the batsman again, outside off, Mahmudullah stays back and pushes it to covers.
Slightly short and on off, spinning away with extra bounce, Mahmudullah plays it down to point.
Floated one, around off and turning in, Naim stays back and calmly dabs it down to short third man for a run.

Loopy and full around off, turning in, Mahmudullah uses his wrists as he tries to flick. It takes the inner half of his blade and races wide of short fine leg. The batters collect two. 12 from the over, 34 needed off 48 balls.
Short and wide outside off, slapped to deep cover for a run.
Quicker and on middle, Mahmudullah gets back and tucks it behind square leg for a run.

SIX! This one has been dismissed. Loopy ball, full and around off, Mahmudullah sits down on one knee and muscles it with the spin. Makes an excellent connection and sends it flying over square leg for a biggie.
Short in length around off, Mahmudullah blazes his pull shot to deep mid-wicket and the fielder in the deep makes a tumbling stop. Two runs taken, 50 up for Bangladesh!
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Mahmudullah reaches out for it as he attempts to drive but misses.
Cole McConchie is back on. 2-0-18-1 are his figures so far.

Advances down the track and then adjusts his shot. He tries to defend but it takes his pads and rolls to mid-wicket. The batsmen cross for a leg bye. This stand moves to 16, 46 needed more off 54 balls.
Turning down the leg side, Naim nudges it behind square leg for a single.
Short in length, outside off, Mahmudullah camps back and pushes it with the spin to deep cover for one.
Quicker one, around off and skidding away, Naim pushes it off the outer half to point and collects a single.
Loopy and full around off, Naim presses forward in defense.
Play and a miss! Full and flighted outside off, Naim goes for a big shot, swings his bat at it but fails to connect.
Full outside off, Naim drives it through the line. Uppish but in the gap at cover-point for one.
On a length outside off, Naim pushes it to point. A bit uppish but safe.
Good length around off, Naim looks to flick but gets a leading edge to covers.
Uppsih but safe! Full ball outside off, Naim pushes it uppishly towards cover. The fielder dives forward but it falls short. The fielder only parries it to long off and the batters pick up two.
Full toss around middle, Mahmudullah flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short ball on off, Naim pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Colin de Grandhomme is introduced into the attack.
Shortish on off, Mahmudullah stands tall inside the crease and does well to control the extra bounce. He plays it down to short mid-wicket. Another tidy over by Rachin.
Flatter ball outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it to point.
Slower through the air on off, Mahmudullah plays it to the off side.
Outside off, punched to covers.
Flighted ball on off, Mahmudullah pushes inside the line and helps it softly to short third man. Looks for a run but is sent back.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Tossed up on off, it spins back into the batsman. Naim looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. An appeal is made by the keeper but the umpire turns it down. The batsmen cross.
Full on off, Naim works it to deep square leg for a single.
On off, pushed down to long off for one.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah drives it to covers. Another dot.
Flighted ball on off, turning away. Mahmudullah taps it to point.
Shortish and outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it to deep point for a couple of runs.
Flighted ball outside off, Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Flighted ball on middle, Mahmudullah works it to square leg for one. Tidy stuff from Rachin.
Loopy ball outside off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but misses as it skids past the outside edge.
Tossed up on middle, Mahmudullah defends it back to the bowler.
Shortish on middle, Naim works it wide of long on for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Naim defends it to the leg side.
Flatter on middle, Naim punches it back to the bowler.
New Zealand are clawing their way back in this match. 62 needed off 84 balls and in walks Mahmudullah.​ Rachin Ravindra to operate now.

OUT! TIMBER! Rahim goes as well and New Zealand are not out of this game yet! Ajaz Patel is turning the game on its head once again! Tossed up around off, Rahim goes on his knees and looks to sweep but it takes the inner half and cannons onto the stumps. Ajaz Patel has removed two big batsmen of Bangladesh in one over. Game on! At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 32/3!
Loopy ball on off, Rahim plays it to covers.
Full on off, Rahim pushes it back to the bowler.
Mushfiqur Rahim is in next at number 4.

OUT! STUMPED! Ajaz Patel strikes and removes the star batsman! He fires across a full ball wide outside off, Shakib advances down the track to whip it on the leg side but the ball skids past his bat. Latham does the rest. Shakib is too far ahead of the crease. New Zealand needed this wicket.
Commentary.Howout: st Tom Latham b Ajaz Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball on the pads, Naim nudges it to short fine leg for one.
Floated on middle, Shakib works it to the leg side for one at backward square leg.
Beaten! Sharp spin. Flatter one, full around off and turning away, Naim pushes at it and misses. Another expensive over, Bangladesh need 64 more to seal the deal.
SIX! Tonk! What a strike! Cole McConchie serves it short and around off, Mohammad Naim uses the depth of his crease and pulls it over wide long on for a maximum.
Floated one, full and on middle, Naim pushes it back to the bowler.
Shot! Loopy one, full and around off, Naim clears his front leg as he goes down and powers his sweep to deep mid-wicket for two.
Shortish and on off, punched to extra cover where the fielder dived and parried it towards mid off. The batsmen crossed.
Quicker one, full and angling down, Shakib tries to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads.

Slower one, a touch short and around middle, Shakib plays late and dabs it down in front of short third man for a brisk single. 8 from the over, 17 in the last two. New Zealand need to stop the flow of runs.
Back of a length, around off and angling away, Naim hangs back and deflects it late down to third man for a run.
Fuller and wide outside off, Shakib plays a mistimed off drive, wide of mid off and picks up a single.
Very full and around leg, Naim tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the off side. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. They cross and it's given as a leg bye.

FOUR! Lovely placement! Fuller in length and outside off, angling away, Naim looks for a booming drive initially but then finds the ball to be leaving him. He adjusts well and guides it through the gap between short third man and backward point. Deft.
Fuller and around off, Naim pushes it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
Hamish Bennett has a change of ends.
FOUR! Shakib is off the mark with a boundary. Poor delivery, short and wide outside off, Shakib rocks back and slaps it through point for a boundary. End of an eventful over.
Quicker one, full and around off, skidding in, Shakib defends it back off the inner half.
Short and wide outside off, Naim cuts it through the gap at point for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Naim drives but finds the cover fielder.
Shakib Al Hasan is the next man in.

OUT! Liton falls. Very ungainly shot to say the least. Floated one, full and outside off, Das goes down on one knee to power it over the leg side. No proper connection as it flies off the top half and Finn Allen, in the deep mid-wicket region, sets off late but then takes a fabulous catch diving forward. A needless shot and Liton's ordinary form continues. 86 needed off 106 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Finn Allen b Cole McConchie

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Wonderful shot and here comes the first boundary of the chase. Too full and around off, Liton brings his bottom hand into play as he whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Cole McConchie is into the attack.
Short and spinning away outside off, Liton cuts it past the diving point fielder for a single. 2 coming from the second over as well. Sedate start from Bangladesh.
Wide! Sprays a full ball down the leg side, Liton tries to sweep but misses.
Beauty! Ajaz gives it a good toss and lands it on middle, turning away, Liton tries to defend but it beats the outside edge.
Flighted and on middle, that is defended solidly off the front foot.
A touch flatter and shorter around off, turning away, Das moves back and is squared up a bit. The ball takes the outer edge and rolls to short third man.
Loopy and full around off, Das is forward as he pushes it defensively to cover-point.
Slower through the air, a touch short and outside off, Das cuts but finds the point fielder.
Who will bowl from the other end? Ajaz Patel it is.
Edgy! Short in length and outside off, Liton flirts inside the line and edges it wide of short third man. The fielder makes a diving stop but cannot prevent the single. 2 coming from the first over.
Fullish and on off, Das sticks back and opens the face of his bat late as he pushes it to short third man.
Slower one, full and on middle, Das is early into his flick shot and plays it aerially. The ball lands safely in front of the mid-wicket fielder.
Very full in length and wide outside off, Naim squeezes it out wide of point for a run. Bennett tumbles in his followthrough but is fine to continue.
Pitches it up and around off, Naim drives it down the ground but finds mid off. A  couple of dots from Hamish.
Bennett begins with a shortish ball around off, angling away, Naim taps it down to short third man and looks for a run. He is sent back.
